## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `refactor`, `test`, `chore`).
- [ ] Behaviour changes ship with a test that fails without the change.
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm e2e` passes, if a crucial feature changed.
- [ ] The spec in `docs/specs/` is updated, if behaviour changed.
